author: tincmetals98
body:
I recorded the past hour. About 5 m/s or 10mph seems to be the limit. Updates were comming in bursts every several seconds of 6 to 15m. Sprints often won't count. A great running speed will be too much. A fair run or good jogging pace is acceptable for Orna.

Bike speed would be equivalent to sight seeing pace. :)

author: Smallsey
body: Could this be linked to Fitbit? Like adventure sync in pokemon go

author: Maudeth
body: Leisure pace on a bike, speed walking. Stop and go in a car.

author: Jaruden
body: You have to go pretty slowly.  Anything up over 14-15 mph definitely doesn't record.  Maybe < 10.  I think it's designed to count walking primarily.

author: sirFleetfoot
body: If it's anything like Ingress/ any of the Niantic game, walking speed is going to be around 6-8kmph. This is for the kms to count. At higher speeds you'll still get spawns, but the addition to distance travelled might not happen.

author: Vyvrhel
body: Don't be lazy and go walking. It's the best physical activity (sex excluded) you can have to maintain yourself in shape. What sense it makes to play a GPS game and not to go out?
